# DCSimulator

> Dividend income calculator: estimate how much capital you need to live off dividends after tax. Monte Carlo includes fees, inflation and dividend growth.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://dcsimulator.me/): Inverse dividend calculator — enter your desired monthly income and get the required capital, adjusted for taxes, fund fees, inflation and dividend growth, with Monte Carlo simulation (P10–P90 scenario bands).
- [Methodology](https://dcsimulator.me/methodology.html): How the model works — net yield formula, tax/fee/inflation treatment, and how the Monte Carlo simulation generates percentile-based outcomes.
- [Blog](https://dcsimulator.me/blog.html): Index of dividend investing guides, FIRE case studies and ETF comparisons.
- [About](https://dcsimulator.me/about.html): Project background, multi-country tax modeling (US withholding + local rates for IT/ES/FR/NL/UK/DE), and a free dividend-tracking spreadsheet template.

## Blog Articles
- [Dividend Investing for Beginners](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-dividend-basics.html): Dividend yield, payout safety, growth trajectories, and quality criteria before sizing a portfolio.
- [Is a Dividend Safe? Payout Ratio & Cut Risk](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-dividend-safety-payout-ratio.html): Payout ratio vs. free cash flow coverage, red flags, and a checklist to stress-test income plans.
- [Dividend Snowball: DRIP Compounding Over 30 Years](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-drip-dividend-snowball.html): How $10K becomes $1M+ through automatic dividend reinvestment — the psychology and math of the snowball effect.
- [How Much Capital for $500–$2,000 Monthly?](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-dividend-amounts.html): Required capital across three yield scenarios and how savings rate impacts the timeline.
- [$1,000/Month Case Study](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-1000-dividends.html): Required capital, yield assumptions, and safety margins for the most common dividend income goal.
- [$100,000/Year Dividend Income](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-100k-dividends.html): Capital requirements for six-figure annual dividend income, including taxes, inflation, and stress testing.
- [Best Dividend ETFs 2026](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-best-dividend-etfs.html): SCHD vs VYM vs DGRO vs JEPI — yield, fees, dividend growth, and portfolio fit.
- [Dividend Yield vs Capital Growth](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-yield-vs-growth.html): Head-to-head comparison of historical returns, tax efficiency, and timeline analysis.
- [FIRE Calculator Guide: Reading Percentiles](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/Page2.html): How to interpret Monte Carlo simulation outputs and scenario bands (P10–P90) for allocation decisions.
- [From Zero to $1,000/Month Roadmap](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/Page.html): Step-by-step roadmap with milestones, guardrails, and a savings-rate-based timeline.

## Italian-Language Articles
- [Vivere di Rendita in Italia: 500 euro/mese](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-vivere-rendita-500-euro.html): Calcolo netto con tasse al 26%, inflazione e DGR per una rendita di 500 €/mese.
- [ETF Accumulo vs Distribuzione (Italia)](https://dcsimulator.me/blog/article-etf-accumulo-vs-distribuzione.html): Differenze, impatto fiscale, compounding e strategia in due fasi per passare dall'accumulo alla rendita.

## Key Topics
- Inverse dividend/capital calculation (income target → required capital)
- Net yield vs gross yield
- Multi-country dividend tax modeling (US withholding + local rates)
- Monte Carlo scenario analysis (P10–P90 percentile bands)
- Dividend growth, inflation and expense ratio modeling
- Dividend ETF comparison and FIRE planning
